Title: Hydroponic Spinach: pH, EC, Temperature & Bolting Guide
Description: Grow hydroponic spinach at pH 6.0, EC 1.8–2.3, air 68–77 °F and water near 64–68 °F to slow root rot. Baby leaf in 12–16 days, full leaves in 5–7 weeks. Free guide from HydroRigor, with figures from university and extension research.
Keywords: hydroponic spinach, hydroponics, indoor gardening, grow vegetables indoors
